records.explanation: Variant B converts at about 44.4% against 39.7% for A, and a two-proportion z-test gives z ≈ 7.43, well above the 1.96 cutoff for 95% significance.
records.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.variant, SUM(d.taps)::numeric AS taps, SUM(d.installs)::numeric AS installs
  FROM reporting.experiment_daily d
  JOIN reporting.experiments x ON x.experiment_id = d.experiment_id
  WHERE x.experiment_name = 'Product page: new screenshots'
    AND d.variant IN ('A','B')
  GROUP BY d.variant
), p AS (
  SELECT
    a.taps AS n_a, a.installs AS x_a,
    b.taps AS n_b, b.installs AS x_b,
    a.installs / a.taps AS p_a,
    b.installs / b.taps AS p_b,
    (a.installs + b.installs) / (a.taps + b.taps) AS p_pool
  FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.variant = 'A' AND b.variant = 'B'
), z AS (
  SELECT p_a, p_b,
    (p_b - p_a) / NULLIF(SQRT(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1 / n_a + 1 / n_b)), 0) AS z_score
  FROM p
)
SELECT p_a AS cvr_a, p_b AS cvr_b, z_score,
       CASE WHEN ABS(z_score) > 1.96 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS significant_at_95
FROM z

records.explanation: For 'Product page: shorter subtitle', the lower end of the 95% confidence interval for B's conversion rate minus A's is about -1.69 percentage points. This comes from a standard two-proportion interval on total taps and installs per variant.
records.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT d.variant, SUM(d.taps)::numeric AS n, SUM(d.installs)::numeric AS x
  FROM reporting.experiment_daily d
  JOIN reporting.experiments e ON e.experiment_id = d.experiment_id
  WHERE e.experiment_name = 'Product page: shorter subtitle'
  GROUP BY d.variant
), r AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='A' THEN x/n END) AS pa,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='A' THEN n END) AS na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='B' THEN x/n END) AS pb,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant='B' THEN n END) AS nb
  FROM v
)
SELECT ROUND(100*((pb-pa) - 1.96*SQRT(pa*(1-pa)/na + pb*(1-pb)/nb)), 3) AS ci_lower_pp
FROM r;

SELECT k.keyword_id, k.keyword, SUM(kd.spend / CASE WHEN c.currency = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE fx.units_per_usd END) AS spend_usd, SUM(kd.installs) AS installs, SUM(kd.spend / CASE WHEN c.currency = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE fx.units_per_usd END) / SUM(kd.installs) AS cost_per_install_usd
FROM reporting.keyword_daily kd
JOIN reporting.keywords k ON k.keyword_id = kd.keyword_id

JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = ag.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN reporting.fx_rates fx ON fx.day = kd.day AND fx.currency = c.currency
GROUP BY k.keyword_id, k.keyword
HAVING SUM(kd.installs) >= 1000
ORDER BY cost_per_install_usd ASC
